ops.entry: WHEN you rate a gating finding lower than its raiser and no squad may remedy it DO escalate both ratings by name, plus whether each prescribed remedy actually remedies it — the split and the remedy fit are what the tier above decides, and reconciling either hides it.
ops.why: Final-round escalation was decidable only because both ratings were carried AND the lead showed the terminal descope remedied neither finding; the ruling adopted both points verbatim.

ops.entry: WHEN ruling a must-fix against a defect class DO hand down the class's full state matrix — every axis the decision consumes, each state a caller can produce — and require a discriminating mutant per cell; an instance-scoped remedy closes one member per round, and rounds are budgeted.
ops.why: Two classes cascaded one member per round until the brief listed the full state matrix and demanded discriminating mutants; generalizes the old input-axis wording to any defect class.

ops.entry: WHEN runner receipts are green DO report them as that host's interpreter and environment, never as CI, until every required CI lock and interpreter version has run — host env can mask CI failures; a failure outside the verify set is an assurance gap first, then an ownership question.
ops.why: My digests headlined 'CI is green' from host-run receipts; a CI-only interpreter version then failed because host colour env masked it. Sharpens G-03 without growing it.

originals.original: WHEN you rate a panel's gating finding lower than the reviewer who raised it and no squad may remedy it DO escalate carrying both ratings by name, not one reconciled rating — the split is the decision the tier above must make, and reconciling it hides that it was contested.

WHEN ruling a must-fix against a class of unusable input DO name every axis the decision consumes — container shape, each read field's type and domain, and related records' identity — a remedy scoped to the observed instance leaves the adjacent axis for the next round, and rounds are budgeted.

WHEN scoped feature gates are green DO not report whole-suite compatibility until every required CI lock has run; a failure outside the verify set is an assurance gap first, then a source-ownership question for the dependency-owning module.
